decisions.reason: The area elastic sports floor builds on established sports flooring know-how and costs little to keep listed, and with no evidence after 2019 its value is still uncertain, so the option stays open.
Arena mobile floors are long-cycle project business whose demand was likely delayed by the pandemic, so it is too early to abandon this option, though it overlaps with Product C.
A second mobile arena system duplicates Product B and is the likelier candidate for consolidation, but without results showing failure the cheap option is kept for now.
The chevron parquet is a flagship that fits the firm's trend-led residential direction, and herringbone and chevron demand stays strong, so the firm should commit to it further.
The squash court finish is a niche add-on with very low carrying cost that complements the sports floor range, so keeping the option is cheap.
Oak skirting is a low-cost accessory that supports the sports floor systems, so dropping it would release few resources.
